security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown code spans, code fences, documentation links, and NestJS troubleshooting text. Two medium-confidence findings remain confirmed because the skill recommends npm script execution, which can run project-controlled code. No evidence of prompt injection, secret exfiltration, or malicious network behavior was found.

Label shell snippets as optional diagnostics and prefer Read, Grep, or Glob inspection before external commands.

content.value_statement: NestJS projects can become difficult to debug when modules, providers, tests, and authentication interact. This skill gives focused guidance for architecture decisions, dependency injection fixes, validation, and test strategy.
actual_capabilities: Diagnoses NestJS module imports, provider exports, and dependency injection errors.
Guides controller, DTO, pipe, guard, interceptor, and middleware implementations.
Plans Jest, Supertest, integration, and e2e testing strategies for NestJS projects.
Advises on TypeORM, Mongoose, and Prisma integration patterns in NestJS applications.
Reviews Passport, JWT, ConfigModule, and environment-based authentication setup.
Provides code review checklists for architecture, performance, testing, and security.
limitations: Requires project files or error messages to give precise guidance.
Does not replace a full security review of production authentication flows.
May need current framework documentation for newly released NestJS behavior.
Command examples should be reviewed before execution in untrusted repositories.

use_cases.title: Resolve Dependency Injection Errors
use_cases.description: Find missing providers, incorrect exports, circular dependencies, and testing module setup issues.

use_cases.title: Design Maintainable NestJS Modules
use_cases.description: Plan feature modules, shared modules, repository boundaries, and request lifecycle components.

use_cases.title: Improve Test and Auth Coverage
use_cases.description: Create focused Jest, Supertest, JWT, Passport, and configuration validation strategies.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Module Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my NestJS module setup for dependency injection issues. Explain missing providers, imports, and exports in simple steps.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Request Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this controller and DTO flow. Find validation, serialization, pipe, guard, or interceptor problems and suggest a focused fix.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Test Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a NestJS test plan for this feature. Include unit tests, integration tests, e2e tests, required mocks, and validation order.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Architecture Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this NestJS service for module boundaries, database integration, authentication configuration, performance risks, and operational failure modes.

output_examples.input: A service fails with a dependency resolution error after adding a new module.
output: Identify the missing constructor dependency from the error position.
Check whether the dependency is listed in providers and exported across module boundaries.
Recommend refactoring shared logic before using circular dependency helpers.

output_examples.input: A team wants stronger JWT configuration and test coverage.
output: Confirm that ConfigModule loads before JWT configuration.
Require environment validation for the signing secret and expiration values.
Add focused unit tests for guards and e2e tests for protected routes.

output_examples.input: A NestJS API has slow database-backed endpoints.
output: Look for N+1 query patterns, missing indexes, and excessive serialization work.
Suggest DataLoader, query builder changes, caching, or pagination where appropriate.
Validate the fix with targeted tests and before-after performance measurements.

best_practices: Share exact error messages, module files, provider definitions, and relevant test setup.
Ask for validation order before running project scripts in a local repository.
Apply recommendations in small steps and verify each change with focused tests.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for unrelated frontend, database-only, or TypeScript-only problems.
Do not add forwardRef before checking whether module boundaries should be redesigned.
Do not run package scripts from untrusted repositories without reviewing them first.

faq.question: What NestJS problems does this skill handle best?
faq.answer: It is strongest for module architecture, dependency injection, controllers, request lifecycle components, testing, databases, and authentication.

faq.question: Can it debug circular dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify circular imports and suggest refactoring, shared modules, or forward references when appropriate.

faq.question: Does it support testing advice?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Jest, Supertest, testing modules, provider mocks, integration tests, and e2e validation order.

faq.question: Can it help with TypeORM and Mongoose?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review connection setup, entity or schema registration, repository injection, migrations, and testing patterns.

faq.question: Does it replace a security audit?
faq.answer: No. It can review common JWT and Passport mistakes, but production systems still need dedicated security review.
